Before another response, require all of these reset conditions: the response has completed; all of this NPC's controls are released; natural recovery has completed; the previous bound event has ended; the trigger condition has cleared before rearming; a new event instance occurs; the target has re-entered the near band. source_path_convention: Source roots are relative to the SelectiveAgency repository. Each case may override the default source_root; source_video is relative to the applicable root. sha256 describes the displayed video; source_sha256, when present, describes original_video.

hnm_selection.scope: All 27 trigger-positive RA cases for H01–H08/H10 plus all 6 NOOP cases.
hnm_selection.method: Existing scores informed shortlist review; frame-by-frame visual clarity determined one choice per rule. These are curated examples, not representative benchmark performance.
hnm_selection.note: H09 was replaced by NOOP cases in this run.

sf3_selection_review.comparison_scope: 49 retained candidates: 27 positive reactivity cases and 6 NOOP cases, including 16 additional VQ-selected seeds; compared with all 10 previous website SF3 clips.
sf3_selection_review.note: Curated qualitative examples. Existing benchmark scores are not recomputed. VQ-selected alternate seeds were assessed visually here, not assigned the RA scores of a different seed.
